Invoices are payable Net 90. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 2.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.
findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms mean you will wait up to three months to get paid for your work, which creates a significant cash flow risk.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable Net 30. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.5% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a good week. I am looking forward to getting started, but I would like to request a few adjustments to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the clause stating: 'Invoices are payable Net 90. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 2.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.', Net 90 payment terms mean waiting up to three months to get paid, so please change this to: 'Invoices are payable Net 30. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.5% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.' Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
